actual_scope: Classify single-source-insertion feasibility for two demanded rows with one restored arbitrary dirty spare over every associative unital ring. Construct an eight-ADD word from a principal-left-ideal witness; specialize it to the polynomial Cohn demand.
scope_change_reason: Follow Open next question of PR5211. This is an algebraic stabilization result, not a changed G20 supplier, physical caller or improvement in kappa.

stop_rule: Stop at the first verified restoring construction and insertion-count criterion. Do not seek a shortest ADD word or expand into a supplier.
